items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him. Yeah, and I met his son too.

ctx.x: Well, Hazel. Hazel Scott. I used to listen to her when she was in her bag of doing . . . jazzing the classics. At the time that I listened to that, I thought that was very hip. I was still in England, hearing those things.
Did you know her husband, Adam Clayton Powell.
I met him. Yeah, and I met his son too.
